summary: The PR addresses the issue by ensuring that the necessary attributes are initialized before being accessed, but it could be improved for clarity and efficiency.

issues.description: The PR calls `do_3d_projection` every time `get_facecolor` or `get_edgecolor` is called if the attributes are not initialized, which may introduce unnecessary computation and performance overhead.
The added comments could be more descriptive about why the projection needs to be done in these methods.
